title: Steel
description: Steel - A Forge-based performance pack focused purely on optimization. No QoL features.
body:
[![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/steelpreformace?logo=modrinth&color=28a745&labelColor=555555)](https://modrinth.com/modpack/everything-voxy) 
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Server-7289da?logo=discord&labelColor=555555)](https://discord.gg/D7U7J8H6Xb) [![YouTube](https://img.shields.io/badge/Subscribe-FF0000?style=flat&logo=youtube&logoColor=white&labelColor=FF0000)](https://www.youtube.com/@GGWoofXD) [![Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Support_on_Ko--fi-13C3FF?style=flat&logo=kofi&logoColor=white&labelColor=13C3FF)](https://ko-fi.com/ggwoof) [![Twitch](https://img.shields.io/badge/Follow_on_Twitch-9146FF?style=flat&logo=twitch&logoColor=white&labelColor=9146FF)](https://www.twitch.tv/ggwoofxd)

Steel is built with one clear goal: making your game run as fast, smooth, and stable as possible. Every component in this Forge-based pack is designed strictly for optimization, reducing stutter, improving resource handling, and maintaining consistent performance in all situations.

The pack avoids unnecessary Quality of Life features, prioritizing instead the technical improvements that truly matter for responsiveness and frame stability. It remains lightweight and efficient, providing a raw foundation where every configuration is tuned so the game loads faster, runs smoother, and stays stable even in demanding areas.
